title: Memory OS Preview Canonical Adapter Record v1
description: Exactly one adapter output record as carried in one Preview spool frame. The frame payload bytes are authoritative: they must equal the deterministic Go encoding/json serialization of the record with the field order fixed by this schema's required lists (compact separators, HTML-escaping of '<', '>' and '&'). Byte-length limits are authoritative in the Go implementation; JSON Schema maxLength approximates them in code points. Rejection records structurally cannot carry raw user values.

occurredAt.description: RFC3339Nano UTC exactly as produced by Go time.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), or the empty string when the source row carries no date. The fingerprint binds this exact string.

fingerprint.description: hex SHA-256 of TrimSpace(title), occurredAt, TrimSpace(url) and TrimSpace(text) joined by 0x1F, matching the genericcsv adapter fingerprint

issues.description: non-blocking warnings attached to an accepted row; may be empty
